cypher.nodes_by_label: MATCH (n) WHERE n.backbone_version = $version UNWIND labels(n) AS kind RETURN kind, count(*) AS count ORDER BY kind
cypher.nodes_by_source: MATCH (n) WHERE n.backbone_version = $version RETURN n.source AS kind, count(*) AS count ORDER BY kind
cypher.relationships_by_type: MATCH ()-[r]->() WHERE r.backbone_version = $version RETURN type(r) AS kind, count(*) AS count ORDER BY kind
cypher.relationships_by_source: MATCH ()-[r]->() WHERE r.backbone_version = $version RETURN r.source AS kind, count(*) AS count ORDER BY kind
cypher.relationships_by_evidence: MATCH ()-[r]->() WHERE r.backbone_version = $version RETURN r.evidence_class AS kind, count(*) AS count ORDER BY kind
cypher.counts: MATCH (n {backbone_version: 'v3'}) WITH count(n) AS nodes MATCH ()-[r {backbone_version: 'v3'}]->() RETURN nodes, count(r) AS relationships
cypher.node_provenance:
MATCH (n {backbone_version:'v3'}) RETURN count(n) AS total,
    count(CASE WHEN n.source IS NULL OR n.source_version IS NULL OR n.updated_at IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS incomplete
cypher.relation_provenance:
MATCH ()-[r {backbone_version:'v3'}]->() RETURN count(r) AS total,
    count(CASE WHEN r.source IS NULL OR r.source_version IS NULL OR r.updated_at IS NULL OR r.evidence_class IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS incomplete
cypher.pathway_depth:
MATCH p=(:Pathway)-[:SUBPATHWAY_OF*0..20]->(root:Pathway)
    WHERE NOT (root)-[:SUBPATHWAY_OF]->() RETURN max(length(p)) AS depth
cypher.pathway_top_categories:
MATCH p=(x:Pathway)-[:SUBPATHWAY_OF*0..20]->(root:Pathway)
    WHERE NOT (root)-[:SUBPATHWAY_OF]->() AND (x)-[:SUBPATHWAY_OF]-()
    RETURN root.pathway_id AS top_id, root.name AS category, root.source AS source,
    count(DISTINCT x) AS pathways, max(length(p)) AS depth ORDER BY source, pathways DESC, top_id
cypher.metabolite_families:
MATCH (m:Metabolite {backbone_version:'v3'})
    RETURN coalesce(m.chemical_family,'other') AS family, count(m) AS total,
    sum(CASE WHEN 'v2' IN m.selection_routes THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS v2
    ORDER BY family
cypher.metabolite_classes:
MATCH (m:Metabolite {backbone_version:'v3'})
    RETURN coalesce(m.class,'unclassified') AS class, count(m) AS total ORDER BY total DESC, class
cypher.stage_genes:
MATCH (s:Stage {backbone_version:'v3'})
    OPTIONAL MATCH (g:Gene)-[:ASSOCIATED_WITH {backbone_version:'v3'}]->(s)
    RETURN s.stage_order AS stage, s.name AS name, count(DISTINCT g) AS genes ORDER BY stage
cypher.gene_patterns:
MATCH (g:Gene {backbone_version:'v3'})
    RETURN g.stage_pattern AS pattern, count(g) AS genes ORDER BY pattern
cypher.stage_changes:
MATCH (:Gene)-[r:STAGE_DIFFERENTIAL {backbone_version:'v3'}]->(:Stage)
    RETURN r.from_stage AS from_stage, r.to_stage AS to_stage, r.change AS change, count(r) AS genes
    ORDER BY from_stage, change
cypher.classification:
MATCH (root:BackboneClass {class_id:'LiverTrail:Entity'})
    OPTIONAL MATCH (type:BackboneClass)-[:IS_A {backbone_version:'v3'}]->(root)
    RETURN root.snapshot_id AS snapshot, collect(type.entity_label) AS entity_classes
cypher.constraints:
SHOW CONSTRAINTS YIELD name, entityType, type, labelsOrTypes, properties
    WHERE name STARTS WITH 'livertrail_backbone_' RETURN name, entityType, type, labelsOrTypes, properties ORDER BY name
cypher.metabolite_disease_counts:
MATCH (:Metabolite)-[r:METABOLITE_ASSOCIATED_WITH_DISEASE {backbone_version:'v3'}]->(:Stage)
    RETURN r.source AS source, r.evidence_class AS evidence_class, count(r) AS count
cypher.pilot_grounded_paths:
MATCH (b {backbone_version:'v3'})<-[:SAME_AS {run_id:$run_id}]-(c:Concept)
  MATCH (c)-[r {run_id:$run_id,source:'literature',gate:'AUTO'}]->(:Concept)
  UNWIND r.evidence_uids AS evidence_id
  MATCH (e:Evidence {uid:evidence_id})-[:IN_ARTICLE {run_id:$run_id}]->(a:Article)
  RETURN count(DISTINCT r.uid) AS relations_with_chain, count(DISTINCT e.uid) AS evidence_with_chain, collect(DISTINCT a.pmid) AS pmids

cypher.chain:
MATCH (m:Metabolite)<-[:SAME_AS]-(c:Concept)-[r:METABOLITE_ASSOCIATED_WITH_DISEASE]->(d:Concept)
    -[:SAME_AS]->(s:Stage) MATCH (e:Evidence) WHERE r.run_id=$run_id AND e.uid IN r.evidence_uids
    RETURN m.metabolite_id AS metabolite, s.name AS stage, r.stage_order AS stage_order,
    r.novelty AS novelty, r.evidence_class AS evidence_class, e.pmid AS pmid, e.text AS quote,
    e.char_start AS start, e.char_end AS end
cypher.backbone_literature_relation:
MATCH (:Metabolite)-[r:METABOLITE_ASSOCIATED_WITH_DISEASE]->(:Stage)
    WHERE r.run_id=$run_id AND r.source='literature' RETURN count(r) AS count
